def move(terrain, start, duration_s, n_runs, seed):
    import numpy as np
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)

    steps = 60
    dt = duration_s / (steps - 1)
    t = np.linspace(0, duration_s, steps)

    # Initialize arrays
    points = np.full((n_runs, steps, 3), np.nan, dtype=float)
    # Start points all equal, shape (n_runs, 2)
    lat0 = np.full(n_runs, start[0])
    lon0 = np.full(n_runs, start[1])
    points[:, 0, 0] = lat0
    points[:, 0, 1] = lon0
    points[:, 0, 2] = 0.0

    # Identify local ridge highest point NE of trailhead within 500 m radius
    # Prepare a fine grid around start to find highest local ridge point NE
    # "local ridge" heuristic: high elevation & slope > 10 deg
    # Search circle radius ~ 500m to find ridge (reasonable local scale)
    rsearch = 500
    n_grid = 20  # grid resolution in each direction

    # Create offsets from start: meshgrid lat/lon deltas for ~500m radius
    # One degree ~ terrain.m_lat, terrain.m_lon meters
    # delta_deg = dist_m / meters_per_degree
    dlat_max = rsearch / terrain.m_lat
    dlon_max = rsearch / terrain.m_lon

    lat_offsets = np.linspace(0, dlat_max, n_grid)  # only NE quadrant (lat >=0, lon >=0)
    lon_offsets = np.linspace(0, dlon_max, n_grid)
    grid_lat_off, grid_lon_off = np.meshgrid(lat_offsets, lon_offsets, indexing='ij')
    grid_lat = start[0] + grid_lat_off.ravel()
    grid_lon = start[1] + grid_lon_off.ravel()

    # Clamp into bounds (not strictly necessary, but safe)
    grid_lat, grid_lon = terrain.clamp(grid_lat, grid_lon)

    # Evaluate elevation and slope at grid points
    elev = terrain.elev(grid_lat, grid_lon)
    slope = terrain.slope_deg(grid_lat, grid_lon)

    # Mask points with slope >=10 deg (ridge terrain)
    ridge_mask = slope >= 10
    # Among ridge points, find highest elevation
    if np.any(ridge_mask):
        elev_ridge = elev[ridge_mask]
        idx_max = np.argmax(elev_ridge)
        ridge_points_lat = grid_lat[ridge_mask]
        ridge_points_lon = grid_lon[ridge_mask]
        target_lat0 = ridge_points_lat[idx_max]
        target_lon0 = ridge_points_lon[idx_max]
    else:
        # No ridge found: fallback to highest elevation NE quadrant
        idx_max = np.argmax(elev)
        target_lat0 = grid_lat[idx_max]
        target_lon0 = grid_lon[idx_max]

    # Direction bearing NE start->target:
    def bearing_rad(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
        dlat = (lat2 - lat1) * terrain.m_lat
        dlon = (lon2 - lon1) * terrain.m_lon
        return np.arctan2(dlon, dlat)

    bearing = bearing_rad(start[0], start[1], target_lat0, target_lon0)

    # For each run, randomize target position slightly within 30m radius circle around target
    # This simulates slightly different ridge points encountered by different runs
    angle = rng.uniform(0, 2*np.pi, n_runs)
    radius = rng.uniform(0, 30, n_runs)
    dlat_rand = (radius * np.cos(angle)) / terrain.m_lat
    dlon_rand = (radius * np.sin(angle)) / terrain.m_lon
    target_lat = target_lat0 + dlat_rand
    target_lon = target_lon0 + dlon_rand
    target_lat, target_lon = terrain.clamp(target_lat, target_lon)

    # Initial positions current lat,lon per run
    cur_lat = lat0.copy()
    cur_lon = lon0.copy()
    cur_t = np.zeros(n_runs)

    # Prepare arrays to record positions
    points[:, 0, 0] = cur_lat
    points[:, 0, 1] = cur_lon
    points[:, 0, 2] = cur_t

    for i in range(1, steps):
        # Vector from current to target
        dlat = (target_lat - cur_lat) * terrain.m_lat
        dlon = (target_lon - cur_lon) * terrain.m_lon
        dist = np.hypot(dlat, dlon)
        # If distance < 1m, stay put
        arrived = dist < 1.0

        # Bearing towards target
        bearing_to_target = np.arctan2(dlon, dlat)

        # Determine small step distance: assume preferred speed depends on slope
        # Compute slope gradient in direction move
        # Approximate elevation difference over distance
        elev_cur = terrain.elev(cur_lat, cur_lon)
        elev_tar = terrain.elev(target_lat, target_lon)
        d_elev = elev_tar - elev_cur
        d_horiz = np.maximum(dist, 1e-3)  # avoid zero div
        speed = terrain.tobler_speed_ms(d_elev, d_horiz)
        travel_dist = speed * dt

        # Cap step to remaining distance
        step_dist = np.where(arrived, 0, np.minimum(travel_dist, dist))

        # New position after offset
        new_lat, new_lon = terrain.offset(cur_lat, cur_lon, bearing_to_target, step_dist)
        new_lat, new_lon = terrain.clamp(new_lat, new_lon)

        # Update time, positions
        cur_lat = np.where(arrived, cur_lat, new_lat)
        cur_lon = np.where(arrived, cur_lon, new_lon)
        cur_t = cur_t + dt

        points[:, i, 0] = cur_lat
        points[:, i, 1] = cur_lon
        points[:, i, 2] = cur_t

    # Check if inside terrain at all points
    inside = terrain.inside(points[:, :, 0], points[:, :, 1])
    ok = inside.all(axis=1)

    return points, ok
